rows.shows: Each row is a CCMenuItemToggle of PlayerMenuItems by toggle number: you [1], a player out [11]; best buddies [2 Buddies, 3 Only Ally]; allied [4 Buddy! (he asks too) or 5 Buddy?, 6 Allies, 7 Declare War]; not allied [8 Ally! (he asks) or 9 Ally?, 10 Enemy]; the item showing is the first when your best-buddy / alliance bit is set, 6 when only your alliance is, else the last. "Allied" and "best buddies" are the game's masks (both sides' bits as they stood when the last turn began); the other bits are the players' own.
rows.how: Read (FUN_10003a0ec, FUN_10003a148, the masks +0x1114 / +0x1116, the selected index).
rows.diff: The game's masks are the remake's G.pactPrev (the pact lists as the last end turn left them); a ruleset that keeps none uses its live pacts. The locked 'Buddies' alone (the game's option 0x10) is never set by the iOS New Game. A ruleset with no best buddies has the allied row [Allies, Declare War].

rows.shows: A tap steps to the next item and sets or clears your own bit: not allied: item 0 asks for an alliance, 1 withdraws it; allied: item 0 asks for best buddies, 1 withdraws that (else asks for the alliance again), 2 withdraws the alliance; best buddies: 0 asks, 1 withdraws.
rows.how: Read; every state and tap tried in the page.
rows.diff: A tap on your own row or on a dead player's runs the toggle all the same: on your own it sets your best-buddy bit toward yourself; on a dead ex-ally or ex-buddy it sets or clears your bits toward him; on one never allied it asks him for an alliance (+0x1114). The row shows nothing for any of it (its word is none), so the remake does nothing (read 0x10009e34c, 0x10003a0ec, 0x10003a148).

rows.how: Read 0x1000c8ed0 with FUN_100035dd4 / FUN_100035fa8 (the lists) and FUN_10003a0ec / FUN_10003a148 (the mutual allied and best-buddy masks at +0x1d0, +0x1f0; the star's owner as you know it against the game's player number at +0x28, which CGame::GetMyPlayerNumber reads in the Android build); the fleet's own name (the first byte of its record, 10 letters then Misc 41) is never written: its only writers would be FUN_10003ca24's callers, which are the ship types' names, so no fleet has one.
